ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines AB and CD intersect at point O, $\angle COE$ is a right angle, $OF$ bisects $\angle AOE$, $\angle COF=34^\circ$, what are the measures of $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle COE=90^\circ$ and $\angle COF=34^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle EOF=\angle COE-\angle COF=56^\circ$,\\
Given that OF is the bisector of $\angle AOE$,\\
it implies $\angle AOE=2\angle EOF=112^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle AOC=112^\circ-90^\circ=\boxed{22^\circ}$,\\
Since $\angle BOD$ and $\angle AOC$ are vertical angles,\\
we conclude that $\angle BOD=\boxed{22^\circ}$.
